newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to check on ships operating in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Japan to check on ships operating in Gulf.

text.p: Japan's Transport Ministry said on Tuesday that it has asked a shipping association to check on Japanese ships in the Gulf, following a U.S. cruise missile strike against Iraqi air defence targets.

A ministry official said the ministry had asked the Japanese Shipowners' Association to study and report on the number and situation of Japan-flagged ships and ships with Japanese crew operating in the Gulf.
An official with the association, which counts 148 member companies, said that the majority of ships heading to Japan from the area were oil tankers.
He added that there had been no reports of problems for ships in the area.
He said that it was unlikely that the Gulf would become totally inaccessible during the current crisis.
